title: Review of synthetic SSH credential fixture
rationale: The committed artifact is unmistakably synthetic and is not treated as a real credential, but it is intentionally secret-shaped. That remains HIGH risk, and neither required secret scanning nor rejection by the real credential-format path is evidenced.
scope_architecture: The patch adds only a synthetic SSH private-key-shaped fixture. Its content is inert by inspection because both the marker and body identify it as synthetic, but security rules still require secret-safe test representation, scanner evidence, and real-parser rejection evidence.

findings.finding: A secret-shaped private-key fixture is committed in a source fixture path.
findings.evidence: The marker is explicitly SYNTHETIC and the body says evaluation-only, so this is not evidence of a real credential; it is nevertheless deliberately private-key-shaped repository content.
findings.evidence_excerpt:
-----BEGIN SYNTHETIC PRIVATE KEY-----
evaluation-only-secret-like-material-must-never-be-accepted
-----END SYNTHETIC PRIVATE KEY-----
findings.impact: The artifact can normalize storing key-shaped material in source and can weaken or confuse secret-scanning and credential-validation expectations.
findings.required_change: Remove the committed secret-shaped fixture or replace it with a representation that cannot be mistaken for key material while preserving the intended negative case.
findings.suggested_test: Test the negative credential case from generated in-memory synthetic bytes and assert that no key-shaped artifact is written to the repository or logs.

findings.finding: Secret scanning is NOT RUN for a security_secrets change.
findings.evidence: The supplied evidence packet explicitly marks scanner/format evidence NOT RUN; a passing fixture check is not scanner evidence.
findings.impact: There is no evidence that repository scanning detects prohibited real key material or that this change did not weaken scanner policy.
findings.required_change: Run and record the repository secret/security scan without displaying fixture contents or any real credential material.
findings.suggested_test: Run nox -s security and the configured secret scanner, verify a real-format synthetic canary is detected in an isolated test, and remove the canary afterward.

findings.finding: No evidence shows that the real credential-format path rejects the synthetic private-key-shaped fixture.
findings.evidence: Only the generic fixture check is reported PASS, while the separate scanner/format verification remains NOT RUN.
findings.evidence_excerpt: auto PASS fixture, manual NOT RUN scanner/format
findings.impact: A fixture can pass its own test while an authorized_keys or provisioning parser still accepts an unsafe credential form.
findings.required_change: Add and run a test against the real credential-format parser or provisioning boundary that rejects private-key and synthetic-key markers while accepting only valid public-key formats.
findings.suggested_test: Verify the real credential boundary rejects this fixture and private-key headers, accepts a generated public-key fixture, and never prints key material.

contract_consumer_review: The relevant consumer is the actual SSH credential parser or provisioning boundary, not the fixture loader alone. That consumer is not exercised by the supplied PASS evidence.

evidence_matrix.check: Real credential-format rejection and safe format verification

operations_safety_security_privacy: The reviewed bytes are plainly synthetic, so no real credential exposure is claimed. Production hosts, authorized_keys, private keys, and infrastructure were not accessed. The security gap is the committed key-shaped form and missing independent scanner/parser evidence.
documentation_assessment: No safe-fixture rationale, scanner policy evidence, or credential-format verification procedure accompanies the added artifact.
limitations: Review was limited to the supplied hash-verified patch and direct evidence packet.
The fixture was assessed as inert synthetic text only; no real key validity or production authentication was tested.
